author: 钟文富
description: Save the system clipboard content (including a timestamp) to the current note: on desktop, it is automatically appended upon copying, while on mobile, it is saved manually via a command. - This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.

manifest.author: WorkBuddy
manifest.description: Auto-save system clipboard contents (with timestamp) to the current note. Desktop appends on copy; mobile saves via command.
manifest.name: Clipboard Saver

name: Clipboard Saver

releases.author: zhongwenfu00-alt
releases.description:
Clipboard Saver 1.0.3.

- Desktop: auto-appends clipboard text (with timestamp) to the current note on copy.
- Mobile: tap the ribbon icon (or run the command) to save the current clipboard to the note.
